dedupe_keys.name: gtfs jp open data map archive of japanese public transport gtfs gis jp

description: This page is an archive of national maps that show the preparation and publication status of public transport open data in Japan in the standard bus information format (GTFS-JP). The page was updated on 31 July 2026. It states that the maps may be used freely as long as the data sources and the creator shown on each map are credited, and that no separate credit is needed if these remain legible. Coverage: Japan, by municipality and operator. Format and access: map images on a public page. Licence and cost: free use with credit. Caveats: the maps show where feeds exist, not the feeds themselves, and the page is in Japanese. It supports network flow studies by showing where Japanese timetable data are available before building models. It relates to the GTFS-JP format and the list of Japanese GTFS open data in the catalogue.
